name: Zapier MCP
summary: Zapier MCP exposes actions from Zapier's 9,000+ app integrations as tools to any MCP client, such as Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor. Zapier keeps the app credentials, and you choose which actions each server allows or let the AI add them as needed. Tool calls draw on the same task quota as Zaps.
facts: 2 Zapier tasks per successful tool call
OAuth from the client; Zapier holds app credentials
goodFor: Personal or team assistants acting in everyday SaaS
Non-developers wiring tools into an AI client
watchOut: Task-based billing adds up with chatty agents
Sharing a server needs a Team or Enterprise plan
Actions use your own Zapier app connections
